# Riyada Ventures — HESP (Heavy Equipment Spare Parts)

> Saudi Arabia's B2B supplier of OEM and aftermarket spare parts for heavy
> construction, mining, and power equipment. Genuine and OEM-quality parts for
> Caterpillar (CAT), Komatsu, Volvo CE, JCB, Hitachi, Doosan, Bobcat, Cummins,
> Perkins, Liebherr, John Deere, and Deutz. Bilingual site (English/Arabic).
> Riyadh warehouse — same-day pickup, 48-hour delivery across Saudi Arabia,
> shipping to the wider GCC. Quote/RFQ sales model (no online checkout).

Arabic name: ريادة فنتشرز — قطع غيار المعدات الثقيلة

- [Brands](https://hesp.riyada-ventures.com/en/brands): the 12+ OEM brands we stock parts for

- [Blog](https://hesp.riyada-ventures.com/en/blog): maintenance guides and parts know-how

- Business type: B2B distributor/supplier of heavy equipment spare parts
